audit.whatIsWrong: The lane is sold as Illaoi's from level 1, and the chart's last row says Illaoi while its own why-text says the matchup flips to Cho'Gath at two items.
audit.why: Rupture reaches 950 to Test of Spirit's 900, so the level-1 range battle is not free; the mirror audit (chogath__illaoi) set the chart to Skill / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill / Illaoi / Cho'Gath, and whys[6] here already describes the late flip. Row 6 rendering 'Illaoi' next to text saying Cho'Gath wins is a visible contradiction.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 1 to Skill, row 6 to Cho'Gath, as matched full/content pairs with ratings, aligning with the mirror and with the existing why-text.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown or range number appears anywhere, and Feast is treated as a non-factor at every stage.
audit.why: Rupture is a flat 6s at 950 range, Feral Scream 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s in a 300 cone, Feast 80/70/60s true damage that ignores armour, Harsh Lesson 4s, Test of Spirit 16/15/14/13/12s. Feast's true damage and percent-health nature mean Illaoi's armour and Sterak's HP do not answer it late.
audit.corrected: 6s/950 Rupture, 9s Feral Scream and Feast's true damage written into the cooldown block, the trigger card, key interactions and the level-6 why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Feral Scream's silence is named only in a Don't headline with unrelated filler underneath, and nothing states what it actually denies.
audit.why: Feral Scream silences in a 300-range cone on a 9s cooldown at rank 5 — inside that window Illaoi can cast neither Test of Spirit nor Harsh Lesson, which is Cho'Gath's whole answer to the engage. Test of Spirit's 900 range is outside the cone, so the counterplay is casting from max range rather than walking in first.
audit.corrected: Silence range and effect written into the Don't card and the key-interactions slot; 'throw E from 900, outside it' as the concrete counter.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file tags Rupture with a 'grounding' flag.
audit.why: Riot's own description says only that it pops enemies into the air, damages and slows — no grounding. Per the trust-the-description rule I asserted nothing about grounding, and wrote the knockup and slow instead.
audit.corrected: Nothing claiming Rupture grounds was written.

edits.before: You dominate level 1 — E range and Q tentacle poke punish Cho with no trade tool of his own.
edits.after: Skill at 1: his Rupture reaches 950 to your E's 900, so whoever lands first owns the trade.

edits.before: Level 2 stays yours as W Harsh Lesson lets you dash in and out of smash trades he can't answer.
edits.after: Skill at 2: Harsh Lesson closes on a 4s cooldown, but Feral Scream's silence answers it.

edits.before: Level 6 R Leap of Faith drowns him in tentacles while his single-target Feast does nothing.
edits.after: Skill at 6: Leap of Faith drowns him in tentacles; Feast's true damage ignores your armour.

edits.before: Telegraphed. Dodge it and slam. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Telegraphed, 6s flat, 950 range — it outranges your E. Dodge it, then slam.
